core.title: IC Core Lever for Panic Device, PDQ 4S-PHL-626-SFL
tags: PDQ-4-SH-0x-PHL-626-SFC IC Core Lever for Panic Device

text.description_html:
PDQ IC Core Lever for Panic Device

This heavy duty lever is suitable for all Wide and Medium Stile Doors. For use on door's exterior with Panic Device Hardware. Covers standard 161 door prep.

For use with PDQ 4200 Series Rim Exit Device, 4200 Series Vertical Rod Exit Device, Polished Brass Vertical Rod Exit Device, Polished Brass Rim Exit Device, Global TH1100EDTBAR Touch Bar Rim Exit Device, TH1100EDSVTBAR Surface Vertical Rod Panic Device.

Packaged with mounting hardware and instructions

Features for PDQ IC Core Lever for Panic Device

  • Rosette Diameter: 3-1/8"
  • Lever Trim: Philadelphia Levers zinc diecast.
  • Lever Length: 5"
  • Lever Projection: 2-3/4"
  • Finish: Satin Chrome
  • Interchangeable Core: Small format IC less core (no lock cylinder). Compatible with Best, Falcon, Arrow 6 or 7 pin cylinders.
  • ADA Compliant
  • PDQ 4-SH-0x-PHL Installation Template & Instructions (PDF)

Philadelphia style lever available in Storeroom and Classroom functions.

When Selecting a Function:

  • Storeroom: Outside lever fixed. Entry by key only. Inside always free (unlocked).
  • Classroom: Outside lever locked and unlocked by key. Inside always unlocked.
